title: AEON Learn canonical semantic lesson
description: The single canonical semantic representation of one session. All output formats (podcast, article, presentation) derive from this document rather than being generated independently (LEARN-11). The ten content slots map to session anatomy A to J (products/learn/session.md).

module_id.description: id of the curriculum module this lesson realises.

language.description: Language of the lesson content, as a BCP 47 tag or a natural-language name.

hook.description: Slot A. Concrete problem, contradiction or scenario that opens the session.

core_concept.description: Slot B. The one dominant idea of the session.

evidence.description: Slot C. Research or primary-source grounding for the core concept, as labelled claims.

items.description: One grounded claim with its epistemic label and sources.

sources.description: Sources supporting the claim: citation, URL or source-map reference. Empty for AEON inference.

interpretation.description: Slot D. What the evidence actually means.

boundary.description: Slot E. What the evidence does not prove.

application.description: Slot F. Concrete application of the concept.

exercise.description: Slot G. Practical exercise the learner performs.

reflection.description: Slot H. Reflection questions; three is the norm per LEARN-S-8 (products/learn/session.md), prose-normative rather than schema-forced.

retrieval.description: Slot I. Recall prompt or prompts reaching back to earlier modules. In the first session this states that there is nothing to retrieve yet.

forward_link.description: Slot J. Why the next module follows logically.
